chunks.text: Microsoft's Exchange Online and Teams went down for hours. More than 130,000 users reported problems, Computer Weekly reports. Computer Weekly calls it a major outage of Microsoft's online applications. Its data shows how deeply the UK public sector relies on these services. Computer Weekly says it is examining what went wrong. A Microsoft outage review found gaps in server testing, The Defiant reports. Could Gulf offices keep working if Teams and email failed for hours?
